name: Bishoujo Youkai Choufukuden Nubatama
original_name: 美少女妖怪調伏伝 ぬばたま
source:
Specters show up in Edo. Politicians are forced to deal with these cases by hiring youkai exterminator. Young main with excellent retreat magic abilities is chosen for the task. Can he really protect the city? And what's the purpose of youkai?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
妖魔开始在江户出没。幕府不得不雇用妖怪调伏师处理这些事件，一名擅长退魔术的年轻男子因此被选中承担重任。他果真能够保护江户吗？这些妖怪现身的目的又究竟是什么？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
